verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Oh Lord You've searched me
You know my ways

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Even when I fail You
I know You love me

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
In every season, I know You love me
I know You love me

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
At the cross I bow my knee
Where Your blood was shed for me

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines: There's no greater love than this

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
You have overcome the grave
Glory fills the highest place

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
You go before me
You shield my way

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
Your hand upholds me
I know You love me

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
You tore the veil
You made a way
When You said that it is done

verse.name: v4a
verse.lines:
And when the earth fades
falls from my eyes

verse.name: v4b
verse.lines:
You stand before me
I know You love me
I know You love me
